note: The 19 factors the psychometric pipeline scores. This file is the controlled vocabulary ONLY — no scores live here and none live on profession records. Its single job in this dataset is to constrain role_spread.deviating_roles, so that variance between job roles inside one profession is expressed in the same language the pipeline already speaks. NEUROTICISM WAS REPLACED BY ITS INVERSE, EMOTIONAL STABILITY, on 2026-08-16. It was the only factor pointing the opposite way from the other eighteen: no profession requires high neuroticism, so a student scoring high on it would have had to be matched to LOW-scoring professions while every other factor matched high to high. A matching engine treating all nineteen alike would have handed anxious students air traffic control. Inverted, every factor now means the same thing - more is more.
usage: role_spread.deviating_roles[].higher / .lower may name ONLY these slugs, and always RELATIVE to the profession's own baseline — never as absolute scores. The validator rejects unknown slugs.
